```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
Feng_Screening<-read_csv("Feng_Screening.csv")
```
```{r}
Feng_Screening%>%summary("Feng_Screening")
```
```{r}
Feng_Screening_Table<-table(Feng_Screening$software,Feng_Screening$booklet)
print(Feng_Screening_Table)
```






```{r}
Read_rt_ms_by_participant<-Feng_Screening%>%group_by(subject_id)%>%summarise(mean_read_rt = mean(read_rt_ms), sd_read_rt=sd(read_rt_ms), min_read_rt=min(read_rt_ms), max_read_rt=max(read_rt_ms))
print(Read_rt_ms_by_participant)
```
```{r}
Read_rt_ms_by_project<-Feng_Screening %>% 
  group_by(project) %>% 
  summarise(proj_mean_read_rt=mean(read_rt_ms), 
            proj_sd_read_rt=sd(read_rt_ms))
print(Read_rt_ms_by_project)

# View(
#   Feng_Screening %>%
#   filter(project == "17_03")
# )
```


```{r}
#Allie Additions 11/2/2026
Extreme_RT_Values_Filtered<-Feng_Screening%>%
  filter(read_rt_ms>=350&read_rt_ms<=18300)
Summary_Filtered_Feng<-Extreme_RT_Values_Filtered%>%
  summarise(filtered_mean_read_rt=mean(read_rt_ms), 
            filtered_sd_read_rt=sd(read_rt_ms), filtered_min=min(read_rt_ms), filtered_max=max(read_rt_ms))
Summary_Filtered_by_Proj<-Extreme_RT_Values_Filtered%>%
  group_by(project)%>%
  summarise(filtered_Pr_mean_read_rt=mean(read_rt_ms), 
            filtered_Pr_sd_read_rt=sd(read_rt_ms),)
print(Summary_Filtered_Feng)
print(Summary_Filtered_by_Proj)
print(Extreme_RT_Values_Filtered)
```



```{r}
Comprehension_Correct_by_project<-Feng_Screening %>% 
  group_by(project) %>%
  summarise(
    proj_mean_comprehension_correct=mean(comprehension_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    proj_sd_comprehension_correct=sd(comprehension_correct, na.rm = TRUE))
print(Comprehension_Correct_by_project)
```
```{r}
Comprehension_Correct_by_subject<-Feng_Screening%>%group_by(subject_id)%>%summarise(subj_mean_comprehension_correct=mean(comprehension_correct), subj_sd_comprehension_correct=sd(comprehension_correct))
print(Comprehension_Correct_by_subject)
```
